name: AI Featured Image
author: Amr Issa

sections.description:
AI Featured Image Generator lets you create AI-powered featured images right from the WordPress editor. Hit “Generate Featured Image” on any post, and the plugin uses your chosen AI provider — OpenAI, Stability AI, or Grok/xAI (all free), or Google Gemini (Pro) — to generate a unique image based on your post title, chosen style, and an optional custom prompt. You can also choose whether to allow text on the generated image or keep it text-free.

Every generated image automatically gets alt text set in the WordPress media library — improving SEO and accessibility without any extra work. You can configure the alt text source (post title, prompt, or a custom template with placeholders like {title}, {style}, and {site_name}), or turn it off entirely from the General settings tab.

Free users get a Bulk Generate tab to create featured images for up to 5 posts per batch (50 images lifetime). Pro users unlock unlimited bulk generation, advanced filters, Gemini support, image upscaling, background removal, and an AI Image Generator block for adding inline images directly inside the Gutenberg editor. Everything is managed from one settings hub.

Video Walkthrough

Free Features

  • 4 AI Providers: Choose from OpenAI, Stability AI, and Grok/xAI — all available on the free plan. Google Gemini is Pro only
  • OpenAI Integration: Generate images using OpenAI’s image generation API
  • Multiple AI Models (OpenAI): Choose from GPT Image 2 (newest, default), ChatGPT Image Latest (auto-updated), GPT Image 1.5, GPT Image 1 (Standard), and GPT Image 1 Mini (budget-friendly). GPT Image 2 excels at text rendering, visual reasoning, and complex multi-object scenes
  • Stability AI Integration: Generate images using Stability AI’s Stable Image Core model — great for photorealistic and artistic images
  • 16 Stability Style Presets: Native API-level style presets including Photographic, Cinematic, Anime, Digital Art, Comic Book, Fantasy Art, 3D Model, Analog Film, Enhance, Isometric, Line Art, Low Poly, Neon Punk, Origami, Pixel Art, and Tile Texture
  • Grok / xAI Integration: Generate images using Grok Imagine Image — the fastest and most affordable option at just $0.02 per image
  • Custom Prompts: Fine-tune results with your own prompt input
  • Generate Prompt from Content: One click generates an AI-optimized image prompt from your post title and body — no manual writing needed. Works with OpenAI and Grok (free) and Google Gemini (Pro). The generated prompt is saved to the post and pre-filled in the Custom Prompt field so you can review or edit it before generating the image
  • 13 Style Presets: Common (None, Realistic, Artistic, Cartoon, Minimalist) and Creative (Sketch, Watercolor, 3D Render, Pixel Art, Cyberpunk, Fantasy, Anime, Technicolor)
  • 7 Image Sizes (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Square 1024×1024, Portrait 1024×1536, Landscape 1536×1024, Widescreen 1792×1024 (16:9), Vertical 1024×1792 (9:16), Ultra-wide 1920×640 (3:1), and Tall Banner 640×1920 (1:3). Older OpenAI models support the first three sizes.
  • 3 Aspect Ratios (Stability AI, free): 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16
  • 3 Aspect Ratios (Grok, free): 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16
  • Output Formats (OpenAI): WebP (default), PNG, or JPEG
  • Output Format (Stability AI): PNG (default)
  • Output Format (Grok): PNG (default)
  • Output Compression (OpenAI): File-size slider from 1–100 for WebP/JPEG output (PNG is lossless)
  • Generation Quality (OpenAI): Low, Medium, or High — trade speed/cost against output detail
  • Transparent Backgrounds (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Generate PNGs with no background for logos, product shots, and compositing
  • Moderation Control (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Choose between auto (standard filtering) and low (for approved accounts that need relaxed moderation)
  • Text Rendering (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Generates clear, correctly spelled text inside images across multiple languages — ideal for banners, quotes, and labelled diagrams
  • Visual Reasoning (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Processes prompts logically before generating, improving accuracy for complex or multi-step scene descriptions
  • Multi-object Scenes (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Handles detailed environments with multiple subjects without objects overlapping or merging incorrectly
  • High Resolution (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Supports up to 4K output and 7 flexible aspect ratios including widescreen (16:9), vertical (9:16), ultra-wide (3:1), and tall banner (1:3)
  • Mask-based Editing (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): GPT Image 2 supports precise, mask-based image editing for targeted changes — enabling you to modify specific areas while leaving the rest intact
  • Text Control: Allow or disallow text, captions, or words in generated images
  • Auto Alt Text: Automatically sets alt text on all AI-generated images for better SEO and accessibility. Choose from post title, generation prompt, or a custom template with {title}, {prompt}, {style}, and {site_name} placeholders. Option to preserve manually edited alt text when regenerating images
  • SEO-Friendly Filenames: Images use your post title for better organization and SEO
  • Bulk Generate (Limited): Up to 5 posts per batch, 50 images lifetime, filtered by post status. Includes option to auto-generate a prompt from each post’s content before image creation
  • Multisite Support: Fully compatible with WordPress multisite

Pro Features 🚀

  • Google Gemini Support: Access Google’s AI image generation with multiple models: Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash), Nano Banana 2 Preview (Gemini 3.1 Flash, higher resolutions), and Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro, premium quality)
  • Image Upscaling (Stability AI): Upscale your existing featured image using Stability AI with three modes — Conservative (faithful 4x upscale), Creative (AI-enhanced 4K), and Fast (quick 4x). Accessible directly from the post editor
  • Background Removal (Stability AI): One-click background removal on your existing featured image, powered by Stability AI. Saves the result as a new PNG attachment and sets it as the featured image
  • Stability AI Advanced Models: Stable Image Ultra (best quality), SD 3.5 Large, SD 3.5 Large Turbo (fast), SD 3.5 Medium, SD 3.5 Flash, SD 3 Large, SD 3 Large Turbo, SD 3 Medium, and SDXL 1.0 (legacy)
  • Negative Prompts (Stability AI): Describe elements to exclude from generated images — e.g. “blurry, watermark, text, low quality”
  • Stability AI Output Format (Pro): Choose PNG, JPEG, or WebP for Stability AI generated images
  • 9 Aspect Ratios (Stability AI): 1:1, 16:9, 21:9, 2:3, 3:2, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, and 9:21
  • Grok Imagine Image Pro: Higher quality Grok model at $0.07 per image
  • 9 Aspect Ratios (Grok): 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 2:1, and 1:2
  • Grok 2K Resolution: Generate higher resolution images with Grok for sharper results
  • Bulk Generate (Unlimited): Generate for hundreds of posts at once with filters for post type, status, date range, and thumbnail status. Select individual posts or all, with real-time progress tracking. Option to auto-generate a content-based prompt for each post before image creation — prompts are saved to each post for review
  • Gutenberg Block: Add AI-generated inline images anywhere in your content using the AI Image Generator block
  • Custom Post Types: Enable image generation for any custom post type, not just posts and pages
  • 10 Aspect Ratios (Gemini): 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9
  • Higher Resolutions (Gemini): Up to 4K with supported Gemini models
  • Custom Styles: Create named styles with custom prompt descriptions that appear in all style dropdowns
  • Inline Image Settings: Dedicated tab for configuring defaults for inline images per provider

Want to unlock Google Gemini AI, image upscaling, background removal, unlimited bulk generation, inline image generation and more? Upgrade to Pro here.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • At least one AI provider API key:
    • OpenAI API key (free plan)
    • Stability AI API key (free plan) — get one at platform.stability.ai
    • Grok/xAI API key (free plan) — get one at console.x.ai
    • Google Gemini API key (Pro plan only)

External Services

This plugin connects to external AI services to generate AI-powered images for your WordPress posts and pages. Free users can choose between OpenAI, Stability AI, and Grok/xAI for featured image generation. Pro users can also use Google Gemini, and can generate both featured images and inline images using the Gutenberg block editor. Stability AI is additionally used by Pro users for image upscaling and background removal.

OpenAI Service (Free & Pro)

When using OpenAI as your provider:
– Your post title and content are sent to OpenAI’s API when you generate a featured image
– When generating inline images (Pro), your custom prompt is sent to the API
– Any custom prompt you provide is sent to the API
– Your OpenAI API key is used for authentication with each request
– Image generation requests are sent to OpenAI’s servers when you click the “Generate Featured Image” button or generate inline images using the Gutenberg block
– When using “Generate Prompt from Content”, your post title and body are sent to OpenAI’s chat API (gpt-4o-mini) to generate an image prompt

Service Provider: OpenAI
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
– API Documentation

Google Gemini Service (Pro only)

When using Google Gemini as your provider:
– Your post title and content are sent to Google’s Gemini API when you generate a featured image
– When generating inline images, your custom prompt is sent to the API
– Any custom prompt you provide is sent to the API
– Your Google Gemini API key is used for authentication with each request
– Image generation requests are sent to Google’s servers when you click the “Generate Featured Image” button or generate inline images using the Gutenberg block
– When using “Generate Prompt from Content” (Pro), your post title and body are sent to Google’s Gemini API (Gemini 2.5 Flash) to generate an image prompt

Service Provider: Google AI (Gemini)
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
– API Documentation

Stability AI Service (Free & Pro)

When using Stability AI as your provider:
– Your post title and content are sent to Stability AI’s API when you generate a featured image
– When generating inline images (Pro), your custom prompt is sent to the API
– Any custom prompt or negative prompt you provide is sent to the API
– Your Stability AI API key is used for authentication with each request
– Image generation, upscaling, and background removal requests are sent to Stability AI’s servers

Pro users can also use Stability AI’s upscale and background removal tools — these send your existing featured image file to Stability AI’s servers for processing.

Service Provider: Stability AI
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
– API Documentation

Grok / xAI Service (Free & Pro)

When using Grok as your provider:
– Your post title and content are sent to xAI’s API when you generate a featured image
– When generating inline images (Pro), your custom prompt is sent to the API
– Any custom prompt you provide is sent to the API
– Your xAI API key is used for authentication with each request
– Image generation requests are sent to xAI’s servers when you click the “Generate Featured Image” button or generate inline images using the Gutenberg block
– When using “Generate Prompt from Content”, your post title and body are sent to xAI’s chat API (grok-3-mini) to generate an image prompt

Service Provider: xAI (Grok)
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
– API Documentation

Data Usage:
– Your post content and prompts are processed by the selected AI provider’s models to generate images
– Generated images are stored in your WordPress media library
– No personal data is stored by the providers beyond what’s necessary for API processing
– You are responsible for ensuring your content complies with the selected provider’s usage policies
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-featured-image-generator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to AI Image in the admin menu to configure your API key and other settings
  4. For Pro users: The AI Image Generator block is available in the Gutenberg block inserter
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes, you need an API key for at least one of the supported providers. All free-plan providers have free tiers or pay-as-you-go pricing:

  • OpenAI: Sign up at OpenAI’s Platform
  • Stability AI: Sign up at platform.stability.ai/account/keys
  • Grok / xAI: Sign up at console.x.ai
  • Google Gemini (Pro only): Get an API key at Google AI Studio

How much does it cost?

The plugin itself is free, but you pay for API usage directly with your chosen provider (pay per image):

  • OpenAI: Pricing varies by model. GPT Image 1 Mini is the most cost-effective; see OpenAI pricing
  • Stability AI: Stable Image Core costs credits (roughly ~$0.003/image). Stable Image Ultra and SD 3.5 models vary; see Stability AI pricing
  • Grok / xAI: Grok Imagine Image costs $0.02/image. Grok Imagine Image Pro (Pro plan) costs $0.07/image
  • Google Gemini (Pro only): Gemini 2.5 Flash uses 1290 tokens per image; Gemini 3.1 Flash and Gemini 3 Pro vary by resolution (1K/2K/4K)

Can I switch between providers?

Yes! All users can switch between OpenAI, Stability AI, and Grok/xAI. Pro users can also switch to Google Gemini. Simply go to AI Featured Image in the admin menu, select your preferred provider, and enter the appropriate API key. The settings page automatically shows only the relevant options for your selected provider.

Is there a limit to how many images I can generate?

The limit depends on your API plan and quota with your chosen provider. The plugin generates one image per request.

What AI models are available?

OpenAI (Free & Pro):
– ChatGPT Image Latest: Always points to the newest ChatGPT image model, so you automatically get improvements
– GPT Image 1.5: Strong quality and accurate text, cheaper and faster than GPT Image 1
– GPT Image 1 (Standard): Premium option for highest quality and finer style control
– GPT Image 1 Mini: Fastest and most cost-effective option

Stability AI (Free: Core only; Pro: all models):
– Stable Image Core (free): Best value, fast and high quality
– Stable Image Ultra (Pro): Best overall quality
– SD 3.5 Large (Pro): High detail, large model
– SD 3.5 Large Turbo (Pro): Fast version of SD 3.5 Large
– SD 3.5 Medium (Pro): Balanced quality and speed
– SD 3.5 Flash (Pro): Fastest SD 3.5 model
– SD 3 Large (Pro): Previous generation, large model
– SD 3 Large Turbo (Pro): Fast SD 3 Large
– SD 3 Medium (Pro): Previous generation, medium model
– SDXL 1.0 (Pro, legacy): Legacy model

Grok / xAI (Free: Standard; Pro: both):
– Grok Imagine Image (free): Fast and affordable at $0.02/image
– Grok Imagine Image Pro (Pro): Higher quality at $0.07/image

Google Gemini (Pro only):
– Gemini 2.5 Flash Image: Fixed resolutions per aspect ratio, 1290 tokens per image, supports all 10 aspect ratios
– Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview: Higher resolution support (1K/2K/4K), supports all 10 aspect ratios
– Gemini 3 Pro Image Preview: Best quality, multiple resolution options (1K/2K/4K), supports all 10 aspect ratios

What styles are available?

The plugin supports 13 built-in artistic styles (works with all providers):
– None: No specific style applied
– Realistic: Photographic, lifelike images
– Artistic: Painterly, artistic interpretations
– Cartoon: Animated, cartoon-style images
– Sketch: Detailed sketch drawings
– Watercolor: Beautiful watercolor paintings
– 3D Render: High-quality 3D rendered images
– Pixel Art: Retro pixel art style
– Cyberpunk: Vibrant cyberpunk aesthetic
– Fantasy: Magical fantasy art style
– Anime: Detailed anime/manga style
– Minimalist: Clean, minimalist designs
– Technicolor: Vivid, colorful technicolor style

When using Stability AI, the post editor also shows a Stability Presets group with 16 native API-level style presets: Photographic, Cinematic, Anime, Digital Art, Comic Book, Fantasy Art, 3D Model, Analog Film, Enhance, Isometric, Line Art, Low Poly, Neon Punk, Origami, Pixel Art, and Tile Texture. These are applied at the API level in addition to any built-in style selected.

Pro users can also create unlimited Custom Styles — see “Can I create my own custom styles?” below.

Can I create my own custom styles? (Pro)

Yes! Pro users can define custom image styles with a name and a prompt description (e.g. “in a dreamy impressionist style”). Custom styles appear under a “Custom” group in all style dropdowns — in the post editor, the settings page, and the inline image block — and work exactly like built-in styles.

To add a custom style:

  1. Go to AI Featured Image → Settings → Featured Images tab
  2. Scroll to the “Custom Styles” section
  3. Click “Add Style”, enter a name and a prompt description, then save
  4. Your custom style will immediately appear in all style dropdowns

What aspect ratios does Gemini support? (Pro)

Pro users with Google Gemini get access to 10 aspect ratios with model-specific resolutions:

All Models (1:1, 3:4, 4:3, 9:16, 16:9):
– Always supported by both Gemini models

Additional Ratios (2:3, 3:2, 4:5, 5:4, 21:9):
– Full support varies by model
– Gemini 2.5 Flash: All 10 ratios with fixed resolutions
– Gemini 3.1 Flash: All 10 ratios with 1K/2K/4K resolution options
– Gemini 3 Pro: All 10 ratios with 1K/2K/4K resolution options

What aspect ratios does Stability AI support?

Free users get 3 basic ratios: 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16. Pro users unlock all 9 ratios: 1:1, 16:9, 21:9, 2:3, 3:2, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, and 9:21.

What aspect ratios does Grok support?

Free users get 3 basic ratios: 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16. Pro users unlock all 9 ratios: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 2:1, and 1:2.

Can I upscale my featured image? (Pro)

Yes! Pro users with a Stability AI API key can upscale their existing featured image directly from the post editor. After generating (or setting) a featured image, a “Stability AI Tools” panel appears below the generate button with three upscale modes:

  • Conservative: Faithful 4x upscale — stays close to the original image
  • Creative: AI-enhanced 4K — adds creative detail for a dramatic quality boost
  • Fast: Quick 4x upscale — fastest option with solid results

Click “Upscale Image”, wait for processing (Conservative and Creative use async processing and may take up to ~3 minutes), and the upscaled image automatically becomes your new featured image.

Can I remove the background from my featured image? (Pro)

Yes! Pro users with a Stability AI API key can remove the background from their existing featured image directly from the post editor. The “Stability AI Tools” panel appears below the generate button once a featured image is set.

Click “Remove Background” and Stability AI will isolate the subject and save a new transparent PNG as your featured image. This is useful for product photography, portraits, or any image where you want a clean isolated subject.

What is a negative prompt and how do I use it? (Stability AI, Pro)

A negative prompt tells Stability AI what not to include in your generated images — for example: “blurry, watermark, text, low quality, distorted”. This can significantly improve output quality by steering the model away from common artifacts.

You can set a default negative prompt for featured images in AI Featured Image → Settings → Featured Images (Stability AI section). Pro users can also set a default negative prompt for inline images in the Inline Images tab.

Negative prompts are a Stability AI exclusive feature and have no effect when using OpenAI, Gemini, or Grok.

What output formats are supported?

OpenAI (Free & Pro):
– WebP (Recommended): Best compression and quality balance
– PNG: Lossless format, good for graphics with sharp edges
– JPEG: Widely compatible, good for photographs

Stability AI:
– PNG (default, free): Lossless format
– JPEG (Pro): Smaller file sizes
– WebP (Pro): Best compression and quality balance

Grok / xAI:
– PNG (fixed): Grok generates images in PNG format only

Google Gemini (Pro only):
– PNG (Fixed): Gemini generates images in PNG format only

How does quality control work?

OpenAI (Free & Pro):
– Set default quality (1-100) in the plugin settings under Featured Images → Output Settings
– Higher quality produces larger file sizes but better image detail
– Default quality is set to 90 for optimal balance

Stability AI:
– Quality is inherent to the model chosen (Core, Ultra, SD 3.5 variants). No separate quality slider

Grok / xAI:
– Free users get 1K resolution. Pro users can choose 1K or 2K for sharper results

Google Gemini (Pro only):
– Gemini 2.5 Flash: Fixed resolution per aspect ratio (quality control not applicable)
– Gemini 3.1 Flash: Choose between 1K, 2K, or 4K resolution options
– Gemini 3 Pro: Choose between 1K, 2K, or 4K resolution options

Inline Images (all providers):
– Automatic Quality Optimization adjusts quality and resolution based on the display size of the image in your content. Smaller images use lighter settings for faster loading; larger images use higher quality to stay sharp. No manual quality slider needed for inline images

Can I generate images inside the Gutenberg editor? (Pro)

Yes! Pro users can generate inline images directly inside the Gutenberg editor using the AI Image Generator block. Simply add the “AI Image Generator” block from the Media category in the block inserter, enter your prompt, and generate images anywhere in your content. The block supports all the same styles, aspect ratios, and settings as featured images. Configure default settings for inline images in the Inline Images tab on the plugin settings page.

How does auto alt text work?

When you generate any AI image (featured, inline, or bulk), the plugin automatically sets the alt text field on the attachment in the WordPress media library. This means your images are immediately accessible to screen readers and better indexed by search engines — no manual work needed.

You can configure auto alt text from AI Images → Settings → General → Alt Text:

  • On/Off toggle: Enable or disable the feature entirely (enabled by default)
  • Post Title (default): Uses the post title for featured and bulk images, and the prompt for inline images
  • Image Prompt: Uses the generation prompt as alt text
  • Custom Format: Build your own template using placeholders — {title} (post title), {prompt} (generation prompt), {style} (style name, e.g. “Realistic”), and {site_name} (your site name). Example: {title} - {style} style - {site_name}
  • Overwrite on Regeneration: When disabled (default), manually edited alt text is preserved when you regenerate a featured image. Enable this option if you want fresh auto-generated alt text each time.

How does “Generate Prompt from Content” work?

Instead of writing a custom prompt manually, click “Generate Prompt from Content” in the post editor to have AI automatically craft an image generation prompt from your post title and body. The generated prompt is saved to the post and pre-filled in the Custom Prompt field — you can review it, edit it, or use it as-is before clicking “Generate Featured Image”.

This option is also available in the Bulk Generate tab. Enable “Generate prompt from content” before starting a bulk run and the plugin will generate a unique prompt for each post before creating its featured image. All generated prompts are saved to each post for later review.

Text model used per provider:

  • OpenAI (Free & Pro): gpt-4o-mini
  • Grok / xAI (Free & Pro): grok-3-mini
  • Google Gemini (Pro): Gemini 2.5 Flash
  • Stability AI: Not supported — Stability AI does not offer a text generation API. The button will show a notice when Stability AI is your active provider

Does it work with custom post types? (Pro)

Yes! Pro users can enable AI image generation for any public custom post type:

  1. Go to AI Featured Image in the admin menu
  2. Scroll to the “Enabled Post Types” setting
  3. Check the boxes for the post types where you want to enable the image generator
  4. Save settings

The AI Featured Image Generator panel will now appear in the editor for all selected post types. Free version users are limited to Posts and Pages only.

short_description: One-click AI featured images using OpenAI, Stability AI, or Grok. Pro adds Gemini, upscaling, background removal & unlimited bulk.
description:
AI Featured Image Generator lets you create AI-powered featured images right from the WordPress editor. Hit “Generate Featured Image” on any post, and the plugin uses your chosen AI provider — OpenAI, Stability AI, or Grok/xAI (all free), or Google Gemini (Pro) — to generate a unique image based on your post title, chosen style, and an optional custom prompt. You can also choose whether to allow text on the generated image or keep it text-free.

Every generated image automatically gets alt text set in the WordPress media library — improving SEO and accessibility without any extra work. You can configure the alt text source (post title, prompt, or a custom template with placeholders like {title}, {style}, and {site_name}), or turn it off entirely from the General settings tab.

Free users get a Bulk Generate tab to create featured images for up to 5 posts per batch (50 images lifetime). Pro users unlock unlimited bulk generation, advanced filters, Gemini support, image upscaling, background removal, and an AI Image Generator block for adding inline images directly inside the Gutenberg editor. Everything is managed from one settings hub.

Video Walkthrough

Free Features

  • 4 AI Providers: Choose from OpenAI, Stability AI, and Grok/xAI — all available on the free plan. Google Gemini is Pro only
  • OpenAI Integration: Generate images using OpenAI’s image generation API
  • Multiple AI Models (OpenAI): Choose from GPT Image 2 (newest, default), ChatGPT Image Latest (auto-updated), GPT Image 1.5, GPT Image 1 (Standard), and GPT Image 1 Mini (budget-friendly). GPT Image 2 excels at text rendering, visual reasoning, and complex multi-object scenes
  • Stability AI Integration: Generate images using Stability AI’s Stable Image Core model — great for photorealistic and artistic images
  • 16 Stability Style Presets: Native API-level style presets including Photographic, Cinematic, Anime, Digital Art, Comic Book, Fantasy Art, 3D Model, Analog Film, Enhance, Isometric, Line Art, Low Poly, Neon Punk, Origami, Pixel Art, and Tile Texture
  • Grok / xAI Integration: Generate images using Grok Imagine Image — the fastest and most affordable option at just $0.02 per image
  • Custom Prompts: Fine-tune results with your own prompt input
  • Generate Prompt from Content: One click generates an AI-optimized image prompt from your post title and body — no manual writing needed. Works with OpenAI and Grok (free) and Google Gemini (Pro). The generated prompt is saved to the post and pre-filled in the Custom Prompt field so you can review or edit it before generating the image
  • 13 Style Presets: Common (None, Realistic, Artistic, Cartoon, Minimalist) and Creative (Sketch, Watercolor, 3D Render, Pixel Art, Cyberpunk, Fantasy, Anime, Technicolor)
  • 7 Image Sizes (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Square 1024×1024, Portrait 1024×1536, Landscape 1536×1024, Widescreen 1792×1024 (16:9), Vertical 1024×1792 (9:16), Ultra-wide 1920×640 (3:1), and Tall Banner 640×1920 (1:3). Older OpenAI models support the first three sizes.
  • 3 Aspect Ratios (Stability AI, free): 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16
  • 3 Aspect Ratios (Grok, free): 1:1, 16:9, and 9:16
  • Output Formats (OpenAI): WebP (default), PNG, or JPEG
  • Output Format (Stability AI): PNG (default)
  • Output Format (Grok): PNG (default)
  • Output Compression (OpenAI): File-size slider from 1–100 for WebP/JPEG output (PNG is lossless)
  • Generation Quality (OpenAI): Low, Medium, or High — trade speed/cost against output detail
  • Transparent Backgrounds (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Generate PNGs with no background for logos, product shots, and compositing
  • Moderation Control (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Choose between auto (standard filtering) and low (for approved accounts that need relaxed moderation)
  • Text Rendering (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Generates clear, correctly spelled text inside images across multiple languages — ideal for banners, quotes, and labelled diagrams
  • Visual Reasoning (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Processes prompts logically before generating, improving accuracy for complex or multi-step scene descriptions
  • Multi-object Scenes (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Handles detailed environments with multiple subjects without objects overlapping or merging incorrectly
  • High Resolution (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): Supports up to 4K output and 7 flexible aspect ratios including widescreen (16:9), vertical (9:16), ultra-wide (3:1), and tall banner (1:3)
  • Mask-based Editing (OpenAI, GPT Image 2): GPT Image 2 supports precise, mask-based image editing for targeted changes — enabling you to modify specific areas while leaving the rest intact
  • Text Control: Allow or disallow text, captions, or words in generated images
  • Auto Alt Text: Automatically sets alt text on all AI-generated images for better SEO and accessibility. Choose from post title, generation prompt, or a custom template with {title}, {prompt}, {style}, and {site_name} placeholders. Option to preserve manually edited alt text when regenerating images
  • SEO-Friendly Filenames: Images use your post title for better organization and SEO
  • Bulk Generate (Limited): Up to 5 posts per batch, 50 images lifetime, filtered by post status. Includes option to auto-generate a prompt from each post’s content before image creation
  • Multisite Support: Fully compatible with WordPress multisite

Pro Features 🚀

  • Google Gemini Support: Access Google’s AI image generation with multiple models: Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash), Nano Banana 2 Preview (Gemini 3.1 Flash, higher resolutions), and Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro, premium quality)
  • Image Upscaling (Stability AI): Upscale your existing featured image using Stability AI with three modes — Conservative (faithful 4x upscale), Creative (AI-enhanced 4K), and Fast (quick 4x). Accessible directly from the post editor
  • Background Removal (Stability AI): One-click background removal on your existing featured image, powered by Stability AI. Saves the result as a new PNG attachment and sets it as the featured image
  • Stability AI Advanced Models: Stable Image Ultra (best quality), SD 3.5 Large, SD 3.5 Large Turbo (fast), SD 3.5 Medium, SD 3.5 Flash, SD 3 Large, SD 3 Large Turbo, SD 3 Medium, and SDXL 1.0 (legacy)
  • Negative Prompts (Stability AI): Describe elements to exclude from generated images — e.g. “blurry, watermark, text, low quality”
  • Stability AI Output Format (Pro): Choose PNG, JPEG, or WebP for Stability AI generated images
  • 9 Aspect Ratios (Stability AI): 1:1, 16:9, 21:9, 2:3, 3:2, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, and 9:21
  • Grok Imagine Image Pro: Higher quality Grok model at $0.07 per image
  • 9 Aspect Ratios (Grok): 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 2:1, and 1:2
  • Grok 2K Resolution: Generate higher resolution images with Grok for sharper results
  • Bulk Generate (Unlimited): Generate for hundreds of posts at once with filters for post type, status, date range, and thumbnail status. Select individual posts or all, with real-time progress tracking. Option to auto-generate a content-based prompt for each post before image creation — prompts are saved to each post for review
  • Gutenberg Block: Add AI-generated inline images anywhere in your content using the AI Image Generator block
  • Custom Post Types: Enable image generation for any custom post type, not just posts and pages
  • 10 Aspect Ratios (Gemini): 1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9
  • Higher Resolutions (Gemini): Up to 4K with supported Gemini models
  • Custom Styles: Create named styles with custom prompt descriptions that appear in all style dropdowns
  • Inline Image Settings: Dedicated tab for configuring defaults for inline images per provider

Want to unlock Google Gemini AI, image upscaling, background removal, unlimited bulk generation, inline image generation and more? Upgrade to Pro here.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • At least one AI provider API key:
    • OpenAI API key (free plan)
    • Stability AI API key (free plan) — get one at platform.stability.ai
    • Grok/xAI API key (free plan) — get one at console.x.ai
    • Google Gemini API key (Pro plan only)

External Services

This plugin connects to external AI services to generate AI-powered images for your WordPress posts and pages. Free users can choose between OpenAI, Stability AI, and Grok/xAI for featured image generation. Pro users can also use Google Gemini, and can generate both featured images and inline images using the Gutenberg block editor. Stability AI is additionally used by Pro users for image upscaling and background removal.

OpenAI Service (Free & Pro)

When using OpenAI as your provider:
– Your post title and content are sent to OpenAI’s API when you generate a featured image
– When generating inline images (Pro), your custom prompt is sent to the API
– Any custom prompt you provide is sent to the API
– Your OpenAI API key is used for authentication with each request
– Image generation requests are sent to OpenAI’s servers when you click the “Generate Featured Image” button or generate inline images using the Gutenberg block
– When using “Generate Prompt from Content”, your post title and body are sent to OpenAI’s chat API (gpt-4o-mini) to generate an image prompt

Service Provider: OpenAI
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
– API Documentation

Google Gemini Service (Pro only)

When using Google Gemini as your provider:
– Your post title and content are sent to Google’s Gemini API when you generate a featured image
– When generating inline images, your custom prompt is sent to the API
– Any custom prompt you provide is sent to the API
– Your Google Gemini API key is used for authentication with each request
– Image generation requests are sent to Google’s servers when you click the “Generate Featured Image” button or generate inline images using the Gutenberg block
– When using “Generate Prompt from Content” (Pro), your post title and body are sent to Google’s Gemini API (Gemini 2.5 Flash) to generate an image prompt

Service Provider: Google AI (Gemini)
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
– API Documentation

Stability AI Service (Free & Pro)

When using Stability AI as your provider:
– Your post title and content are sent to Stability AI’s API when you generate a featured image
– When generating inline images (Pro), your custom prompt is sent to the API
– Any custom prompt or negative prompt you provide is sent to the API
– Your Stability AI API key is used for authentication with each request
– Image generation, upscaling, and background removal requests are sent to Stability AI’s servers

Pro users can also use Stability AI’s upscale and background removal tools — these send your existing featured image file to Stability AI’s servers for processing.

Service Provider: Stability AI
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
– API Documentation

Grok / xAI Service (Free & Pro)

When using Grok as your provider:
– Your post title and content are sent to xAI’s API when you generate a featured image
– When generating inline images (Pro), your custom prompt is sent to the API
– Any custom prompt you provide is sent to the API
– Your xAI API key is used for authentication with each request
– Image generation requests are sent to xAI’s servers when you click the “Generate Featured Image” button or generate inline images using the Gutenberg block
– When using “Generate Prompt from Content”, your post title and body are sent to xAI’s chat API (grok-3-mini) to generate an image prompt

Service Provider: xAI (Grok)
– Terms of Service
– Privacy Policy
– API Documentation

Data Usage:
– Your post content and prompts are processed by the selected AI provider’s models to generate images
– Generated images are stored in your WordPress media library
– No personal data is stored by the providers beyond what’s necessary for API processing
– You are responsible for ensuring your content complies with the selected provider’s usage policies
